items.text: First meeting since the Canadiens beat the Sabres in seven games in last spring’s second round.
The Sabres are newly without Rasmus Dahlin, and have had to make do without Alex Lyon and Jason Zucker all season. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is expected to start.
Nick Suzuki has a point in eight straight games against Buffalo, and 20 points in his last twelve against them.

The Canadiens are newly without Samuel Montembeault and Mike Matheson, have been without Ivan Demidov since Oct 3, and have had to make do without Oliver Kapanen all season. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
